system.name: Vid-LLM
system.one_liner: A compact video-based 3D multimodal LLM that jointly reconstructs the scene and answers 3D language tasks from monocular video only.

content.variant_note: a film strip of video frames above a reconstructed 3D scene and three task cards, each a short chat about the same room
content.argues: One compact model that takes only video can do 3D dense captioning, question answering and visual grounding on the same scene.
content.subject: A video of an office, its reconstructed 3D scene with coloured boxes, and chat examples for three 3D vision-language tasks.

lessons.what_to_learn: State what a single-input model can do by putting one shared input (a film strip) on top, one titled colour-outlined chat card per task beside a central render of the intermediate result, so input, scene and three task examples are seen on the same room.
lessons.suits: Generalist models that take one input type and serve several tasks, especially multimodal LLMs whose answers differ in form (text, count, coordinates).

evidence: We propose Vid-LLM to achieve diverse 3D vision-language reasoning tasks using only video inputs.
a compact model that jointly performs reconstruction and 3D vision–language reasoning from monocular video inputs
Cross-Task Adapter (CTA) that tightly couples reconstruction with reasoning

summary: Vid-LLM is a compact multimodal LLM that reconstructs a 3D scene from monocular video and reasons about it, so one video input serves several 3D vision-language tasks. Figure 1 is a capability overview rather than a method diagram. A film strip of eleven frames of an office runs across the top, with small grey arrows down to a textured top-down 3D reconstruction in the centre, carrying red, green and blue 3D boxes, and to three colour-outlined cards on either side: 3D Dense Captioning, 3D Question Answering and 3D Visual Grounding. Each card is a short chat about the same room, with a face avatar and blue-grey bubbles for the user and a robot avatar with peach bubbles for the assistant; the answers are a description, a count and box coordinates.
summary_zh: Vid-LLM 只用单目视频重建 3D 场景并做语言推理。图是能力总览：顶部是办公室视频胶片条，中间为带彩色 3D 框的重建场景，两侧三张卡片分别展示 3D 稠密描述、3D 问答和 3D 视觉定位的对话，用户与助手以头像和气泡颜色区分。
notes: Prior kinds kept. The extraction includes two stray lines of the author block (Hubei Luojia Laboratory, School of Architecture and Urban Planning) above the strip; they are not part of the figure. The mapping of the red, green and blue boxes to the desk, sofa and chair is inferred from the examples. The film strip frames, bubbles and avatars are all placed bitmaps in the digest (32 pictures).
